ranger.role: first native-R random-forest parity candidate; not scientifically authoritative

jsonlite.role: canonical JSON read/write for locks, expected outputs and manifests

parity_constraints.random_forest: Must reproduce frozen V1 decisions/fixtures. ranger is an implementation candidate only. No retuning or architecture change allowed.
parity_constraints.bootstrap_rng: Must reproduce NumPy default_rng(46073) resampling sequence or demonstrate an exactly equivalent frozen index stream before exact CI acceptance.
parity_constraints.quantiles: Use NumPy linear percentile semantics; R quantile(type=7) is the mathematical counterpart for an identical replicate vector.
parity_constraints.floating_point: Use frozen tolerances and canonical group-index tie-breaks; do not modify scientific thresholds.

renv_lock.reason: No R executable is installed in the current execution environment. A generated renv.lock cannot be truthfully produced or verified here.
renv_lock.next_action: In the first R-capable environment, install R 4.6.1 and renv 1.2.3, install the declared direct packages at locked versions, run renv::snapshot(), record sessionInfo(), and verify restore in a clean library before Step 7B execution claims.

prohibitions: Do not change any frozen model family, grid, gate, metric, split, selector architecture, bootstrap design or acceptance threshold to accommodate R package behavior.
Do not substitute the raw bundle unless a separately named reproduction study is created.
Do not claim an exact R reproduction before deterministic parity tests pass.
